title: Chief Minister & State Council of Ministers
quote: CM = chief link between the Governor and the Council of Ministers (Art. 167)

boxes.title: Position
items: ==**Real executive head**== of the State; head of the Government
Leader of majority in the **Legislative Assembly**; chief spokesperson
**Art. 163**: Council headed by CM **aids and advises** the Governor
**Delhi and Puducherry**: CM appointed by the **President** (**Art. 239AA**)

boxes.title: Article 164 clause by clause
head: Clause
Provision
rows: ==**Governor appoints the CM**== (APPSC-GS 2021); ministers on CM's advice

boxes.title: Powers & Art. 167 duties
items: Furnishes information; submits single-minister decision for Council consideration
Stays only with **Assembly's confidence**; loses it → resign or dismissed

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Art. 164 clauses: (1) appointment, (2) responsibility, (3) oath, (4) **6 months**, (5) salaries
**130th Amendment Bill, 2025**: custody **30 consecutive days**, **5+ years** offence → removed on **31st day** (Arts. **75, 164, 239AA**)
NITI Aayog **11th** Governing Council: all **28** CMs present
First Speaker united AP: **Nallapati Venkata Ramaiah**
